newsitem.title: USA: Coventry says closes Fla. Medicaid plan.
newsitem.headline: Coventry says closes Fla. Medicaid plan.

text.p: Coventry Corp said Tuesday it closed its Florida Medicaid HMO plan effective July 1.
The company said it expects the closing of this HMO plan to have no material financial impact on 1997 results.
The company said it decided to close the plan after unsuccessful attempts to arrange a suitable sale for the HMO.
The company also said Christopher Fey, president and chief executive of its Medicaid subsidiary, HealthCare USA, has resigned to launch a start-up company in the disease management field.
Davina Lane, president and chief executive of HealthCare USA of Missouri, will immediately assume additional duties as president of all of HealthCare USA, it said.
